name: std::semiregular

declarations.code:
template <class T>

concept semiregular = std::copyable<T> && std::default_initializable<T>;

intro: The semiregular concept specifies that a type is both copyable and default constructible. It is satisfied by types that behave similarly to built-in types like int, except that they need not support comparison with ==.
